_comment: Regions published as static tiles. extract = Geofabrik path of the source extract (its .poly marks where data is complete); publish = which area to publish: a Geofabrik .poly path or a circle.

regionRequests._comment: Games ask for new regions through a Google Form (formUrl + field ids are public). The responses CSV link is the REQUESTS_CSV_URL secret of the tiles repository, never stored here. The site URL comes from TILES_SITE_URL in the workflow; an optional app allowlist from the REQUESTS_APPS secret.
